name: Odoo (External DB)
author: Mox Neo
description: Odoo (16/17/18) with external PostgreSQL support. Generates odoo.conf on boot, supports optional Git-based custom addons, and is proxy-friendly for Cloudflare/Tailscale setups.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "[INSTALL] Installing Odoo egg files (no OS package installs here)."
echo "[INSTALL] NOTE: Your server Docker image MUST already include the 'odoo' binary."

cd /mnt/server

# Persistent dirs (map to /home/container at runtime)
mkdir -p data addons logs

echo "[INSTALL] Writing /mnt/server/start.sh ..."
cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /home/container
mkdir -p data addons logs

fail() { echo "[Odoo] config error: $*"; exit 1; }

# Every value written to odoo.conf is validated first: no CR/LF/NUL (which
# could inject extra config keys) and a strict pattern where one fits.
check() {
  local name="$1" val="$2" re="$3"
  case "$val" in *$'\n'*|*$'\r'*) fail "$name contains a line break" ;; esac
  [[ "$val" =~ $re ]] || fail "$name has an invalid value"
}
check DB_HOST "${DB_HOST:-}" '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,255}$'
check DB_PORT "${DB_PORT:-}" '^[0-9]{1,5}$'
check DB_USER "${DB_USER:-}" '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$'
check DB_NAME "${DB_NAME:-}" '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,20}$'
check DB_PASSWORD "${DB_PASSWORD:-}" '^[^[:cntrl:]]{1,255}$'
check ODOO_ADMIN_PASSWD "${ODOO_ADMIN_PASSWD:-}" '^[^[:cntrl:]]{12,128}$'
check ODOO_PROXY_MODE "${ODOO_PROXY_MODE:-}" '^(true|false)$'
check ODOO_LOG_LEVEL "${ODOO_LOG_LEVEL:-}" '^(debug|info|warn|error)$'
for n in ODOO_WORKERS ODOO_MAX_CRON_THREADS ODOO_LIMIT_MEMORY_HARD ODOO_LIMIT_MEMORY_SOFT ODOO_LIMIT_TIME_CPU ODOO_LIMIT_TIME_REAL; do
  check "$n" "${!n:-0}" '^[0-9]{1,12}$'
done

# Regenerated every start, so panel changes apply and nothing is frozen at install.
umask 077
cat > /home/container/odoo.conf.tmp <<CFG
[options]
admin_passwd = ${ODOO_ADMIN_PASSWD}
list_db = False
http_port = 8069
xmlrpc_interface = 0.0.0.0
proxy_mode = ${ODOO_PROXY_MODE}
log_level = ${ODOO_LOG_LEVEL}

db_host = ${DB_HOST}
db_port = ${DB_PORT}
db_user = ${DB_USER}
db_password = ${DB_PASSWORD}
db_name = ${DB_NAME}
dbfilter = ^${DB_NAME}\$

data_dir = /home/container/data
addons_path = /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/odoo/addons,/home/container/addons

logfile = /home/container/logs/odoo.log
CFG
mv /home/container/odoo.conf.tmp /home/container/odoo.conf

echo "[Odoo] Starting..."
echo "[Odoo] DB_HOST=${DB_HOST} DB_PORT=${DB_PORT} DB_USER=${DB_USER} DB_NAME=${DB_NAME} list_db=False"

exec odoo --config /home/container/odoo.conf
EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh

echo "[INSTALL] odoo.conf is generated by start.sh on every start."
echo "[INSTALL] Done."

variables.name: Addons Git Auto Pull
variables.description: If true, pulls latest addons on each start (dev).

variables.name: Addons Git Repo (optional)
variables.description: Optional. Git URL for custom addons repo (HTTPS/SSH).

variables.name: DB Host
variables.description: External PostgreSQL host (LAN IP or Tailscale IP).

variables.name: DB Name
variables.description: The single database this server serves (dbfilter = ^DB_NAME$).

variables.name: DB Password
variables.description: Password for DB user. CHANGE THIS PER SERVER.

variables.name: Max Cron Threads
variables.description: Background jobs. 1 is safe for small installs.

variables.name: Odoo Master Password (admin_passwd)
variables.description: Required (min 12, no control characters). Odoo master password. The web database manager is disabled (list_db = False), so this is a second layer. CHANGE THIS PER SERVER.
